predictions.articleTitle: Decoupling Sigma Olomouc vs Zbrojovka Brno: Expected Goals, Lineup Vulnerabilities & Match Intelligence
predictions.coreRecommendation: Sigma Olomouc's superior early-tempo transition play gives them the edge, though Brno's counter-threat justifies backing Home Win with a Draw safety hedge.
